Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.scheduling

Class KfeChannelCapacityController

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.scheduling.KfeChannelCapacityController
@Service public class KfeChannelCapacityController extends Object
Dead-man capacity loop: usage stress → durable OPEN/CLOSE intents.

Does not open channels on the user request path. Runs async, re-uses binary AND gates at enqueue and execution time, costs from SYSTEM_PROFIT.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeChannelCapacityController

      public KfeChannelCapacityController(LightningChannelGateway channelGateway, KfeChannelDecisionService decisionService, KfeChannelLifecycleService lifecycleService, KfeChannelCapacityQueueService capacityQueue, KfeCapacitySignalStore signalStore, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeLightningOpsMetrics> opsMetrics, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.enabled:true}") boolean enabled, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.auto-open:true}") boolean autoOpen, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.auto-close-dead:true}") boolean autoCloseDead, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.signal-window-ms:900000}") long signalWindowMs, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.liquidity-reject-threshold:5}") long liquidityRejectThreshold, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.open-amount-sats:0}") long openAmountSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.estimated-open-fee-sats:5000}") long estimatedOpenFeeSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.expected-open-gain-sats:50000}") long expectedOpenGainSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.assumed-fee-rate-sat-vb:10}") long assumedFeeRateSatVb, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.inactive-scans-before-close:3}") int inactiveScansBeforeClose, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.max-pending-opens:2}") long maxPendingOpens, @Value("${kfe.channel.capacity.preferred-peers:}") String preferredPeersCsv, @Value("${kfe.channel.min-open-capital-sats:10000000}") long minOpenCapitalSats)
      Creates the asynchronous capacity loop and normalizes configuration bounds before use.
      Parameters:
      channelGateway - Lightning provider channel operations
      decisionService - binary open policy evaluator
      lifecycleService - durable open/close decision service
      capacityQueue - automatic capacity intent queue
      signalStore - liquidity stress signal aggregator
      opsMetrics - optional capacity metrics provider
      enabled - master automation switch
      autoOpen - automatic open policy switch
      autoCloseDead - automatic close policy switch
      signalWindowMs - liquidity signal lookback window, clamped to 60 seconds or greater
      liquidityRejectThreshold - minimum rejection count to trigger open evaluation
      openAmountSats - automatic channel amount, falling back to minimum capital if nonpositive
      estimatedOpenFeeSats - estimated structural open cost, clamped to zero or greater
      expectedOpenGainSats - expected open gain, clamped to zero or greater
      assumedFeeRateSatVb - decision fee rate, clamped to at least one sat/vbyte
      inactiveScansBeforeClose - required consecutive inactive observations, clamped to at least one
      maxPendingOpens - concurrent pending open ceiling, clamped to at least one
      preferredPeersCsv - comma-separated ordered peer public keys
      minOpenCapitalSats - fallback open capacity when no positive explicit amount is configured

  • Method Details

    • scan

      @Scheduled(fixedDelayString="${kfe.channel.capacity.fixed-delay-ms:180000}", initialDelayString="${kfe.channel.capacity.initial-delay-ms:90000}") public void scan()
      Periodically evaluates close candidates and liquidity-driven open candidates when automation is enabled and the Lightning provider is live. Exceptions are contained at scan scope so a transient failure does not stop future scheduled scans.
